# Dilip Kumar (Dilip Kashyap)

> Backend and AI engineer in Hyderabad, India. Two years shipping production systems with Python, FastAPI, Go and Node.js: APIs, authentication, payments, caching and grounded RAG pipelines that only accept answers backed by a verbatim quote from the source. Full-Stack Engineer at Stryv.ai since July 2025. Open to Backend Engineer, AI Engineer and Full-Stack Engineer roles in Hyderabad, Bengaluru or remote.

Website: https://dilipkashyap.in/. Every fact below is also on the website, and the main facts are available as JSON.

## Experience

- Stryv.ai, Hyderabad, Full-Stack Engineer (July 2025 to present): builds the AI automation module of a vendor-compliance platform (hybrid vector + keyword retrieval on PostgreSQL/pgvector, cross-encoder reranking, verbatim-quote validation, async pipelines with human approval); built JWT authentication and OTP password recovery; contributed to an AWS document-verification pipeline that processed 160K documents in a month at about 90% accuracy; owns the backend for assessment workflows and trust-score calculation; helped build a CRM serving 100K+ users in a 20+ person team.
- NexGen Elit, remote, Full-Stack Engineer (June 2024 to July 2025): built a job-portal backend with skill-based assessments and dual-sided subscriptions, integrated Razorpay payments and subscriptions, and built a Node.js/Express backend for a virtual fitness platform with Google Meet integration.

## Projects

- [Jugaad Link](https://jugaadlink.vercel.app): URL shortener in Go (Gin, GORM) with PostgreSQL, Redis-cached redirects, password-protected and expiring links, QR codes and per-link analytics. Code: https://github.com/Dilip-Kashyp/jugaadlink-be
- [Atlas](https://github.com/Dilip-Kashyp/Atles): multi-tenant Slack and GitHub assistant with OAuth 2.0, per-workspace webhooks and a Gemini agent that calls tools (FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Next.js).
- [ContriHub](https://contri-hub.vercel.app): finds beginner-friendly open-source projects, with AI repo explanations and learning roadmaps (Go, PostgreSQL, Redis, Groq, Next.js). Code: https://github.com/Dilip-Kashyp/ContriHub
